_doc: Fixtures for .harmony/probe-render-state.sh (s-rta-0926b render lanes: R2/R4/R5 wave 1; R1, R4-opaque, R4-types, R4 empty active deck: render2). @MEDIA@ is replaced at run time with the checkout's media/ dir. Effects are [name, param...]. Thresholds and calibration: docstring of .harmony/probe-render-state.py.

r2._why: deck 0 (active) layer id 0 = A + fx; deck 1 layer id 0 (persistent, Opaque/Normal, covers the frame) = B + fx. The persistent layer must not share temporal/ring state with the active deck's layer of the same id: subject == reference (same composition, active layer without the effect)

r4._why: base = deck 0 layer id 0 Opaque = A; subject layer id 5 Transparent (Normal, Alpha key) = B + one stage. The subject PERSISTENT on deck 1 must render like the same layer as a NORMAL layer on deck 0

r4_transition._why: deck 1 persistent layer id 5 (Transparent), OUT = A, IN = B, Dissolve over T s. Trigger IN on deck 1, leave the deck 0.3 s later: the crossfade must keep running on the persistent layer

r5_hold._why: layer id 91 (fresh this run), col 0 = A, col 1 = A + [Screen Split, Freeze 1.0]. Freeze 1.0 outputs its history; a fresh history is cleared to transparent black. Creating it INSIDE the Freeze pass left the pass target holding only its glClear (Screen Split's grey) and that became the held history

r5_burst._why: fresh layer ids, col 0 = A, col 1 = A + [Freeze 0.5]; back-to-back captures across the switch. No frame after the switch may be blank (the creation frame used to be fully transparent)
r5_burst._postSwitchS: seconds of back-to-back captures after the switch; 2.0 holds >= 8 full-canvas (1920x1080) captures (was 0.6 s before plan4: 6-7)

r1._why: one layer, OUT = col 0 = A + out, IN = col 1 = B + in, Wipe Left over T s: each region must show ONLY its own clip (ratio vs that clip alone <= bound). Ruling R1 = B': outgoing slot, copy buffer / swap ring

counts._why: fresh layer id, 6 cols alternating A/B each with fx, faded through with T s: exactly +2 frame rings (the layer's + its outgoing slot)

r4_opaque._why: persistent Opaque layer (deck 1, id 5, Normal) over deck 0's A: honours layer opacity through the alpha keying pass and never hides the active deck

r4_fxonly._why: a persistent FX Only layer / a Transparent layer with a media-less effect clip applies its effects over the active deck; a persistent Mask layer stays skipped

r4_empty_active_deck._why: persistent layers must render over an EMPTY active deck exactly as over a black one (wave-1 found_not_fixed #1)
